    GraphQLSchema
    A pure, in-memory model of a GraphQL schema parsed from an introspection response (GraphQLService.INTROSPECTION_QUERY).
    GraphQLSchema.Field
    A field on a type: its name, the (unwrapped) type it returns, and its argument names.
    GraphQLSchema.OperationType
    The three GraphQL root operations.
    GraphQLSchema.Type
    A schema type: its name, kind (OBJECT/SCALAR/…), and fields (empty for non-object types).
    GraphQLService.Result
    Result of a GraphQL call: HTTP status, pretty body, elapsed ms, and any transport error.
    GraphQLWsProtocol.ServerMessage
    A parsed inbound server message: its type, the operation id (may be null for connection-level frames), and the raw payload JSON (may be null).
